explanation: Store a trie edge per next character and an explicit terminal flag at complete keys.
correctness: The path represents a key's exact characters. Only its terminal flag denotes complete-key membership, so shared prefixes never create false complete keys.
walkthrough: Insert https://a/b: create missing character links and mark its final node, returning true. Insert https://a next: its character path exists, but its final node was not a complete key, so return true. Repeating https://a/b returns false. Extending it to https://a/b/c marks a different complete key and returns true. JSON supplies [operationNames,argumentLists] for one fresh Trie. Each AddWord receives one exact string and returns whether that complete key was newly inserted.
edgeCases: shorter prefix inserted after longer key
The empty key marks the root and returns true once, then false. Inserting a shorter prefix after a longer key returns true if its terminal marker was unset.
timeComplexity: Expected O(L+1) time per insertion: follow or create one hash-map edge per character of a length-L key, then inspect its terminal marker.
spaceComplexity: O(P+1) persistent trie storage for P distinct nonempty prefixes; each new key creates only its missing prefixes.
